claims.claim: CorrectionPreflightResult, preflight_remediation, preflight_repair, and the internal implementation necessary solely for Correction Preflight are owned by src/aios_renew/correction_preflight.py, with aios_renew.operator maintaining a source-compatible public re-export.

Correction Preflight remains read-only and preserves READY/BLOCKED behavior for REMEDIATION and REPAIR across current and historical subjects, canonical remote/local lineage, malformed/ambiguous state, duplicate continuation, scope/action binding, and executor-required decisions.
NO_CHANGE reusable-state admission, CODE_FIX ordinary repair readiness, and CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION readiness retain their established ordering and fail-closed semantics.

Unified State and existing Operator callers continue to consume the authoritative Correction Preflight result through the unchanged Operator-facing interface without any second reducer or preflight authority.

src/aios_renew/operator.py is materially smaller in the Correction Preflight domain and retains no duplicate implementation, while the dedicated correction_preflight module owns no Runtime execution, verification, semantic review, publication, retry/reroute, or unrelated Operator authority.

The delta is strictly limited to the three authorized files (src/aios_renew/correction_preflight.py, src/aios_renew/operator.py, tests/test_operator_correction_preflight.py), frozen Kernel artifacts and all canonical schemas remain unchanged, and no tests are deleted, skipped, xfailed, duplicated, or semantically weakened.
The focused Correction Preflight suite plus unchanged Unified State, Human Surface, and remaining Operator regressions pass together under the canonical verification contract.
